name: plan-limits
description: A weather forecast for your context window and your plan's 5-hour and weekly limits, with reset times and this session's cost, above the prompt

ringStyle.title: Ring style
ringStyle.description: The symbol that stands in for the bar on a narrow line: nerd is Nerd Font circle slices in the forecast's colour (needs a Nerd Font), moon is moon-phase emoji in their own colours, circle is plain Unicode quarter circles in the forecast's colour.
